family_name: btrfs qgroup: GFP_ATOMIC extent_changeset ulist_add failure under spinlock -> BUG_ON
definition: btrfs qgroup release/free paths doing GFP_ATOMIC changeset allocations under the extent-io-tree spinlock; allocation failure under memory pressure hits BUG_ON in clear_state_bit (fix: avoid GFP_ATOMIC allocations in qgroup release/free paths).

family_name: sched/fair EEVDF: unclamped reweight_entity vlag -> avg_vruntime overflow -> rq-lock hard lockup
definition: reweight_entity vlag rescale overflows entity_key/avg_vruntime, producing WARN/corruption under rq lock and load-balancer/rq-lock hard lockups (fix: clamp rescaled vlag in reweight_entity).

family_name: btrfs block group: bg_list refcount race in create_pending_block_groups -> UAF
definition: Use-after-free of btrfs block groups in unused-bg deletion, discard or allocator caused by the bg_list refcount race in btrfs_create_pending_block_groups().

family_name: btrfs extent buffer: unbounded writeback-inhibit xarray walk without resched
definition: Soft lockups/RCU stalls from btrfs_uninhibit_all_eb_writeback walking an unbounded xarray at transaction end/eviction (fix: replace writeback inhibition xarray with fixed inline buffer).

family_name: mm list_lru / cgroup writeback: long list spinlock hold in shrinker walk or inode switch -> soft lockup
definition: Soft lockups from long list_lru lock hold in __list_lru_walk_one inode-shrinker walks (amplified on KVM guests) or wb->list_lock contention when switching cgroup writeback inodes.

family_name: mm page tables: concurrent modification race (khugepaged collapse vs PT_RECLAIM, pagewalk PUD split vs refault)
definition: Races between concurrent page-table modifications under per-VMA lock or pagewalk split leading to stale/freed page tables and page-table UAF.

family_name: btrfs extent_map lifecycle: map freed while still on modified_extents/tree (LOGGING flag split, debug BUG)
definition: btrfs split extent_map inherits EXTENT_FLAG_LOGGING and is freed by the shrinker while on modified_extents, plus the Meta-only debug BUG() on freeing an extent_map still in tree.

family_name: btrfs extent-map shrinker: root->inodes xa_lock held across cond_resched_lock -> lock starvation
definition: Lockups from the btrfs extent-map shrinker holding root->inodes xa_lock across cond_resched_lock under PREEMPT_NONE, including unfair virt_spin_lock amplification in VMs.

family_name: btrfs background workers: race/stale state -> infinite loop (kill_all_delayed_nodes xarray race, discard worker)
definition: btrfs cleaner/discard kthreads spin forever due to a race or stale state (inodes xarray eviction race in kill_all_delayed_nodes during subvolume deletion; discard worker after discard disabled).

family_name: bpf arena: VMA dup/remap without vm_open refcount -> double close UAF
definition: bpf arena vma_list entry shared across duplicated VMAs without refcount, causing double list_del/UAF in arena_vm_close (fix: bpf: Fix remap of arena).

family_name: bpf arena: GUARD_SZ/kern_vm_start misalignment on 64K pages -> infinite page-table walk
definition: bpf arena kern_vm_start misaligned on 64K-page kernels so apply_to_pte_range never terminates in arena_map_free (softlockup).

family_name: mm/slub: obj_exts (memcg/alloc-tag) free-path unbounded recursion -> stack overflow
definition: kfree -> __free_slab -> kfree recursion via slab obj_exts allocations causing stack overflow (fix: prevent unbounded recursion with new kmalloc type).

family_name: mm/swap: swap_reclaim_full_clusters unbounded scan without cond_resched
definition: Full-cluster swap reclaim loop under si->lock contention with no resched point, causing softlockups/RCU stalls.

family_name: net NIC drivers (bnxt, idpf): NULL deref of rings/vport on down or resetting interface
definition: Ethernet driver callbacks (netdev-genl qstats, AER error_detected, ethtool) dereference NULL rings/bnapi/vport when the interface is closed or mid-reset.

family_name: sched: wrong sched_class/ownership state assumed on class or mode switch (scx migration threads, mm_cid)
definition: Scheduler state corrupted during a sched_class or mode switch: per-CPU migration threads given wrong class on sched_ext enable, or mm_cid assumed CPU-owned on mode switch (OOB clear on exit).

family_name: fuse readahead: folio lifecycle bugs (splice-move refcount underflow, max_pages==0 ZERO_SIZE_PTR)
definition: FUSE readahead path bugs: folio refcount underflow with splice move corrupting PCP/LRU lists, or ZERO_SIZE_PTR deref when max_pages==0 on 64K-page arm64.

family_name: fs clients (fuse-uring, pNFS flexfiles): wrong NULL/ERR_PTR check or request-less entry -> NULL deref
definition: Network/userspace filesystem client paths dereferencing NULL due to wrong NULL vs ERR_PTR check (ff_layout_choose_ds_for_read) or cancelled request-less fuse-uring entries on ent_in_userspace.

family_name: core/mm/PCI: missing NULL check on absent or uninitialized state (cgroup rstat, swap_cgroup, AER info)
definition: NULL deref because code assumes optional/initialized state exists: css_rstat_exit on uninitialized rstat_cpu in error path, swap_cgroup map on swapless host, NULL aer_info in aer_ratelimit.

family_name: printk/IPI storm: unrate-limited WARN/AER prints or kfence static-key IPI broadcast -> soft lockup/CSD stall
definition: Lockups caused by message floods (arm64 ioremap-on-RAM WARN, PCI AER aer_print_error) or IPI broadcast storms (kfence static-key toggles on VMs).

family_name: sched_ext: put_task_struct under scx_tasks_lock during class switch -> AA self-deadlock
definition: scx_enable class-switch path dropping the last task ref (put_task_struct) while holding scx_tasks_lock, self-deadlocking (fix: use SCX_TASK_READY test instead of tryget_task_struct).

family_name: sched_ext: spurious cgrp_moving_from WARN under rq lock -> netconsole printk self-deadlock
definition: False WARN in scx_cgroup_move_task emitted under rq lock, where netconsole printk recurses into rq lock, causing csd-lock/hard lockups.

family_name: sched_ext: stale dsq->first_task after unlink -> UAF via scx_bpf_dsq_peek
definition: task_unlink_from_dsq leaves a stale dsq->first_task observed by scx_bpf_dsq_peek on FIFO DSQs, causing UAF.

family_name: sched fair/rt: starvation or IPI livelock (CFS throttle of preempted RCU reader, RT push self-IPI)
definition: Scheduler policy logic starves a critical context or loops forever: CFS bandwidth throttling dequeues preempted in-kernel RCU readers (RCU stall), or RT push-IPI rto_next_cpu self-IPI loop.

family_name: mlx5: TX queue/channel lifecycle and FW data validation (reporter UAF, BQL reset, fw_tracer format)
definition: mlx5 driver crashes from TX-timeout reporter UAF after channel reopen, BQL reset with in-flight WQEs on SQ re-activation, and unvalidated FW tracer format strings.

family_name: drivers: current-message/transfer state race between completion and error/timeout paths (ipmi, tegra QSPI)
definition: Driver work/IRQ path uses a current message/transfer pointer that the error or timeout path has already consumed (ipmi smi_work sender-error double list_add/UAF, tegra210-quad curr_xfer NULL race).

family_name: btrfs subpage: relocation folio private freed by reclaim race -> UAF/NULL deref
definition: btrfs_subpage_clear_uptodate during relocation racing with page reclaim releasing folio private data.

family_name: iommu/amd: completion-wait sequence allocation race -> timeouts and dom->lock convoy
definition: AMD IOMMU cmd_sem sequence allocation race under concurrent TLB invalidation (after wait_on_sem-out-of-lock backport) causing completion-wait timeouts and lock convoys.

family_name: perf/x86 PMU: event pointer vs active_mask state race -> NULL event deref
definition: x86/AMD PMU enable/NMI paths dereferencing a NULL event due to event pointer setup ordering vs active_mask.

family_name: tracing probes (uprobes, fprobe): register/unregister race -> NULL deref
definition: uprobe hprobe_expire and fprobe_fgraph_entry racing with concurrent unregister/registration, dereferencing NULL.

family_name: workqueue: watchdog false-positive stall from memory reordering
definition: wq_watchdog reports false stalls due to arm64 memory reordering of pool timestamps.

family_name: timers/migration: tmigr_handle_remote_up hierarchy livelock
definition: Timer migration hierarchy livelock between jiffies advance and remote timer handling in tmigr_handle_remote_up.

family_name: block/net: stale reference after async wakeup or queue change (rq_qos on-stack wait, kTLS anchor) -> UAF
definition: UAF where a waker or reader uses stale data after the owner moved on (rq_qos waker touching waiter's on-stack data, kTLS strparser stale frag_list anchor after TCP queue collapse).

family_name: mm THP: invalid PMD migration entry dereferenced in split_huge_pmd_locked
definition: THP split path treats a PMD migration entry as a present PMD (pmd_folio on a migration entry).
